name: quick-web-analytics
description: Lightweight, privacy-friendly web analytics on Cloudflare

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/tracker && npm run build -w apps/web && node scripts/assemble-assets.mjs
scripts.test: npm test -w apps/worker -w apps/query -w apps/web -w packages/tracker
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/worker -w apps/query -w apps/web
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy -w apps/query && npm run deploy -w apps/worker
